items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah. [INTERVIEWER] You had Elton with you there? Huh? You had Elton with you, you said? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I thought you said you had somebody named Elton. Elton.
Elton used to play. You mean Elton? Yeah. Elton played, Elton played Boundary over Thomas before I started playing. Oh I see.
And he was there that night you didn't make a nickel?
